source_metadata.contact_department: Innere Medizin IV Haematologie und Onkologie
source_metadata.data_processing: Sequences were aligned to the human genome hg19 with alignment program STAR_2.5.2b using Gencode v.25
source_metadata.extract_protocol_ch1: RNA was isolated from cultured hiPS cardiomyocytes using the RNeasy mini kit (Qiagen)
source_metadata.growth_protocol_ch1: Beating iPS- derived cardiomyocytes were maintained in RPMI 1640 medium (Thermo Fisher Scientific) supplemented with B27 supplements (Thermo Fisher Scientific). All experiments were performed between day 31 and day 35 after initiation of differentiation. Human iPS-derived CMs were dissociated using prewarmed TrypLE select 10x (Thermo Fisher Scientific) at 37°C. Next, cells were detached, collected and centrifuged using RPMI 1640 with B27 supplement media. The cells were resuspended in RPMI 1640 with B27 supplement media and plated in Matrigel-coated 6 well dishes.
source_metadata.title: Control replicate 1
source_metadata.treatment_protocol_ch1: hiPS cardiomyocytes were exposed to doxorubicin 1μM and/ or R-2HG (20mM, (Sigma Aldrich, #H8378) for 24 hours in CDM3 medium
